name: Remix: Remix: Remix: Fabrica
description:
"AI knows HOW to build. It just doesn't know WHAT."

Drop in your mess — spreadsheets, old software, scattered files, whatever you've got. Fabrica digs through it, learns how your business actually works, and builds you a real system to run it on. Not a report. Not a one-time answer you throw away tomorrow. A system that keeps working, keeps improving, and never forgets what your business needs. 

Watch your company get built.
